matches.why: Shows specialized Hodge classes of abelian varieties are represented by rational algebraic cycles, a rationality statement tied to the Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties.
Concerns algebraic cycles compatible across prime-to-p and crystalline realizations, close to Tate-type statements.
Rationality and independence of cohomology theory of intersection numbers of algebraic cycles is in the spirit of the standard conjectures.
Proves the full BSD leading-term formula for all elliptic curves over Q with Selmer corank at most one at some prime.
Congruent-number and sum-of-two-cubes type questions are BSD corollaries; the family proves rank-one results for X^3+Y^3=lZ^3.
Proves a zero-free half-plane Re s>7/8 for zeta, a partial result toward RH (quasi-RH).
Zero-free half-plane for all Dirichlet L-functions.
Zero-free half-plane for Hecke L-functions over Q(sqrt-3) and Dirichlet L-functions.
Proves uniform exclusion of Landau-Siegel zeros.
Zero-free region results bear on zero-density estimates.
Zero-free region strongly related to growth of zeta and Lindelof.
Proves Hilbert's tenth problem is undecidable over Q.
Companion result on 2-converse: Selmer corank at most one gives equal analytic and Mordell-Weil rank and finite Sha.
Proves Catalan's constant is irrational, one of the constants listed.
Goldfeld density and rank statistics for quadratic twists with a low-corank Selmer converse, tied to BSD-type rank questions.
Rank distribution of quadratic twists (e.g. of y^2=x^3-x) bears on which numbers are congruent.
Proves the odd regular two-dimensional Fontaine-Mazur conjecture over Q at the prime 2.
